info.title: InpaCare API
info.description:
Contract for the synthetic local demo. Compiled Nest metadata and live JSON-response checks verify the contract. See docs/planning/NESTJS_DECISIONS.md for source-model adaptations.

Runtime route inventory: the legacy API operations plus room/item soft-delete and item edit, placement edit/cancel, medical-record delete and observation correction, cycle dashboard/request detail/delete, invoice patient context/line edit-delete/claim verification, and public health. Mutations require Origin; authenticated mutations also require the session cookie and X-CSRF-Token.

Set-Cookie.description: HttpOnly session cookie; Secure in production; SameSite=Lax.

post.description: Same-origin Origin required. Sets HttpOnly session and readable csrf_token cookies; returns user.csrfToken.
Patient then room lock; checks maintenance, duplicate patient overlaps and daily peak capacity. No cancel or move endpoint.
Coordinator only; room derives from active placement; start and end may match.

patch.description: PIC progress and notes; coordinator cancellation with reason; requires expectedVersion.

delete.description: Coordinator only, expectedVersion and reason required.

patch.description: ADMISI only. Send status, lines (replaces all lines), and/or coveredAmount with reason and expectedVersion. Totals are recomputed server-side; the edit and history entry commit atomically. Status-only requests remain supported.
